Ok, not gonna lie, I really didn’t have any expectations coming in. My husband and I live in Ho Chi Minh long term and pretty much only come into Bui Vien to show guests our exciting backpacker street once every blue moon. And we try not to eat there because locals think of Bui Vien as a tourist trap. Our friends invited us to join them for dinner at Mumtaz’s because they met him a while ago and he had invited them to check out his restaurant.

But WOW was the food ever amazing!!!!!! Our friends ordered a green cheese dish that was To. Die. For. I ordered my favorite,eggplant masala, and hubby ordered his favorite butter chicken. Sorry I don’t know the names of all the dishes, I’m usually not the one who orders when we go for Indian food so I’m not very well versed in dish names.

The best part? No upset stomach issues after! We went home stuffed and happy and slept all night and woke up wanting more of last night’s amazing dinner! So now we’re actually going to have to pop into Bui Vien more often to go eat at Mumtaz’s!!
